messages:
morgan: Quick sync — I'm drafting a compact 'thin client' snippet for the error ref that shows pragmatic handling for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit rejections. want someone to own merging and a tiny smoke test :eyes:

morgan: Proposed scope: one JS + one Python example, cover: Retry-After header, exponential backoff w/ jitter, trimming the prompt (showing how to drop less-important messages), and a graceful fallback to a smaller model. keep it <30 lines each.

devon: sounds good. can we also include a note about not retrying on 4xx other than 429? tiny sentence is fine.

aisha: i can take ownership of the merge and smoke test. will need the final snippets pushed to a branch by tomorrow morning PST.

morgan: awesome, thanks @aisha. i'll push my draft in a PR and tag you. PR will be under docs/err-ref/429-timeouts.

sam: +1 on the Retry-After handling. for JS snippet can we show both header parse and fallback to exponential backoff if absent? e.g.,
```js
// parse Retry-After then fallback to backoff
const wait = resp.headers.get('Retry-After') ? parseInt(...) : Math.min(1000 * 2**attempt, 10000)
await sleep(wait)
```

sam: also add a comment: "do not infinite retry; give up after N attempts"

aisha: perfect. for the prompt trimming example, can we add a tiny heuristic: drop oldest assistant/user pairs until tokens < limit? i'll write a 6-line pseudocode.

leo: ping — docs-bot will auto-run lint but not the SDK snippet tests. @aisha you'll need to create a tiny CI job that runs the snippets in the example harness (sandbox). we have a template at ./docs/.github/snippet-smoke.yml

morgan: thanks @leo. i'll add the PR link when ready. aim is: reviewers should only need to sanity-check language and run the smoke job.

devon: reminder: include a short note about fallbacks changing model outputs. something like "fallback -> lower cost model may change output style; add regression tests for critical prompts."

morgan: agreed, i'll add one sentence under "Fallback behavior" -> link to rollouts page.

docs-bot: New PR opened by morgan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4122 — "thin-client 429/timeouts snippet"

aisha: grabbing the PR now. will add 2 small edits: clarify Retry-After parsing and add the trimming pseudocode. also adding the snippet-smoke job to the PR YAML.

sam: if you want I can quick-run the JS snippet locally and paste outputs in the PR comments (verify no syntax issues).

aisha: that'd be great, thanks @sam — please post any gotchas.

leo: nits to watch for: keep examples using our official SDK import path (not older aliases), and avoid calling out internal-only flags.

morgan: PTAL @aisha @sam @devon — if we get two approvals and the smoke job passes, i'll merge and backfill a small cross-link from the context-limits page.

aisha: plan: i'll push edits by 09:30 PST, run CI, and request review.

sam: ran local sanity check on the JS snippet — minor typo in `parseInt` call, fixed in a comment on the PR. :white_check_mark:

devon: LGTM for the wording changes i suggested, leaving final signoff to aisha.

aisha: PR updated, smoke job added. requesting review @morgan @devon @leo.

docs-bot: CI: snippet-smoke passed for PR #4122 (branch: morgan/thin-client-429-snips)

morgan: merging now. post-merge task: create a 1-paragraph migration note for SDK users who relied on implicit retries. i'll draft that and drop it in product-release notes.

aisha: thanks all. will follow up if smoke reveals anything flakey. :thumbsup:

leo: nice work team — small, focused doc changes like this reduce real customer confusion.
